youtube_description:
Before there was ALL IN THE FAMILY, there were TWO pilots that were rejected by ABC and NBC.  The third time was the charm as CBS commissioned a THIRD pilot with Sally Struthers as Gloria.  

In this rare interview clip, actress Candice Azzara relates how she was cast in the SECOND pilot for the show, originally titled "Those Were The Days"
